scope: Full UI translation coverage for every shipped language, including the native tray menu
implementation: Every shipped non-English catalogue satisfies CompleteLocale
Shared catalogue reader rejects missing keys, blank values, placeholder drift, copied English without a reviewed exemption, and undeclared/partial shipped locales
All newly added natural-language values were reviewed as static locale text; only reviewed brands, protocols, formats and shared vocabulary reuse English values
Rust HTTP responses and native tray labels use one JSON dictionary reader
Tray text follows the saved language on native event processing, using a lightweight configuration-language read
limits: Native menu labels are validated in Rust; live tray interaction is not covered by headless browser tests.
The pre-existing Platform::play too_many_arguments lint prevents strict Clippy. The remaining warnings are checked with only that lint allowed.
User-configured content, canonical key identifiers, plugin IDs, protocol values and external diagnostic details remain data.

bundle.loading: Only English is bundled; the selected full locale is served as JSON. No translation model or new translation service is required by WebDeck.
